subject: self; unknown or other actors require separate R2 clarification/out-of-scope handling
disease_names: open exact source words; no five-name whitelist, local sentence proof, normalization or diagnosis inference
declared_preference_scope: long_term; actual language scope still requires R2
time_source: raw time must occur in user evidence; no normalized dates accepted; no raw time requires unspecified scope
source_ref: current or context_1 through context_4 from trusted source order, never model-supplied DB IDs or hashes
grounding: exact unique quote location in owned user source; at least one current-user evidence reference; server adds real message ID, hash, Unicode offsets and source time
source_context: entire bounded context retained locally, including later caveats; assistant context cannot donate user facts
trusted_adapter_requirements: current collection policy and conversation versions
empty_items: valid structure only; not a successful negative or proof that nothing should be remembered
json_rules: atomic response rejection on bad item
no_provider_payload: source snapshots and grounded packets contain local authority metadata; R2 must construct a sanitized role/content/alias payload and obtain separate processing permission
legacy_compatibility: no imports from production/legacy callers; no change to P01/P02, old assertion enums, confirmation semantics, models, migrations or runtime settings; new packets rejected by legacy candidate validator
